description: This file defines the SessionLog class used for logging responses and user actions during a session, including writing logs to a markdown file and managing log entries with timeout-based flushing.

classes.name: SessionLog
classes.description: A class for managing session logging, including recording responses, user actions, and writing to a markdown file.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create a new SessionLog instance with a session folder generated based on current timestamp.

methods.name: logResponse
methods.description: Logs a response object, capturing tool call details, code, and tab snapshot.

methods.name: logUserAction
methods.description: Logs a user action, including handling updates and navigation actions.

methods.name: _appendEntry
methods.description: Adds a log entry to the pending entries and sets a timeout to flush entries.

methods.name: _flushEntries
methods.description: Flushes pending log entries to the session markdown file, formatting entries and saving snapshots.
